tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search published books and artbooks on Artbook Society. Every keyword must match the title, subtitle, description, an author or contributor, the publisher or the edition type. Optional filters: price range, signed, numbered, limited edition, language.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch full public details for a single published product by its numeric id.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Fetch full public details for a single artist by their numeric id.

tools.name: get_editor
tools.description: Fetch full public details for a single editor by their numeric id.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List published upcoming Artbook Society events, soonest first.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search published books and artbooks on Artbook Society by title." → after: "Search published books and artbooks on Artbook Society. Every keyword must match the title, subtitle, description, an author or contributor, the publisher or the edition type. Optional filters: price range, signed, numbered, limited edition, language."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
